definitions.pointer_loss: 26-symbol CE, mean nominal loops within each example then mean examples.
definitions.stop_loss: Unscaled balanced BCE: equal weight to mean continue BCE and final stop BCE per example; depth 1 has stop BCE only. Mean across examples. Training multiplies this loss by 0.1.
definitions.validation: Charts use 192 fixed examples at depths 1–6. All 256 examples, including 32 each at 7/8, are audited and exported.
definitions.smoothing: Display-only trailing example-weighted mean for training; unsmoothed validation every 250 updates.
definitions.scope: Original development monitoring, not full-population evaluation or measured inference speed.
